name: Navan
description: Navan lets agents read travel and expense data such as spend summaries, transactions, and policy details. Each user signs in to their own Navan account through the browser.

prompts.text: What did our team spend on travel last quarter?
List expenses from last month that are out of policy.
Which hotels and airlines did we spend the most on this year?

apps.name: Navan
apps.description: Travel and expense reporting, over Navan's MCP server with browser sign-in.
